$comment: Content of the README card pictures. Render with sh1ft-w.github.io/theme/v1/readme-images: node render.mjs <this repo> cards. The title image is the original artwork, unchanged.

features.title: Like the dashboard
features.text: Throughput of WiFi, LAN and internet, clients, latency, availability, public IP, provider and critical events, as in UniFi Network.

features.title: Every WiFi network
features.text: On and off, the password as a text field and a QR code to scan, for example on a tablet for guests.

features.title: Firewall and policies
features.text: Every firewall policy, traffic rule and route, port forward, content filter, Policy Engine policy and VPN server as a switch.

features.title: Ports and PoE
features.text: Link speed and throughput per port, ports on and off with their settings restored, PoE on and off and a power cycle.

features.title: Every UniFi device its own
features.text: Access points and switches sit under the router: clients per band, channel, utilization, transmit power, LED, restart, firmware.

features.title: Clients you choose
features.text: Pick the phones that matter: presence, internet access, reconnect, download, upload and WiFi signal for each.

features.title: Speed tests
features.text: Download, upload and ping, a button, an automatic test on your interval and a comparison with the speed you pay for.

features.title: Display and night mode
features.text: The router's display with its brightness, every status LED and the night mode times, plus firmware and UniFi Network updates.

entities.title: Network
entities.text: wan_download, wan_upload, wifi_rx, wifi_tx, lan_rx, lan_tx, clients, internet_latency, wan_availability and critical_events.

entities.title: Internet and speed test
entities.text: speedtest_download, speedtest_upload, speedtest_ping, isp, wan_ip, wan_ipv6, active_wan and the auto speed test switch.

entities.title: Per device
entities.text: cpu_load, memory_usage, cpu_temperature, connected_clients, online, firmware, restart, locate and status_led.

entities.title: Per band and port
entities.text: 2_4_ghz_clients, channel, utilization, transmit_power as a select, port_1, port_1_poe, link speed and PoE power.

entities.title: Switches
entities.text: wifi_*, firewall_*, traffic_rule_*, route_*, port_forward_*, content_filter_*, policy_*, vpn_* and upnp.

entities.title: Per client
entities.text: device_tracker, internet_access, reconnect, download, upload, wifi_signal and ip_address, for the clients you pick.
